title: Map Structure Template
description: A parametric structure for the `construct` operation (design/map-generation.md §6) -- a bunker, a sea fort, any hand-designed content placed by an op rather than imported from OSM. Every part's footprint is in LOCAL METRES, origin at the op's anchor, +Y = the template's own 'north' before the op's rotation is applied (see citymap/ops/construct.py). Parts become ordinary Features carrying real tags, so they inherit the whole renderer -- Minkowski shadows, height-graded fills, road z-order -- for free, exactly like an imported OSM building.

kind.description: 'area' (default) becomes a Polygon -- a building/landuse fill with height, shadow and outline. 'line' becomes a LineString -- a perimeter track, fence line or similar, drawn through the ordinary road/linear-feature pipeline (e.g. tags={'highway':'track'}) rather than filled. Line parts are never treated as placement obstacles or overlap candidates -- only area parts are.

tags.description: OSM-style tags this part renders with -- e.g. {'building':'bunker'} draws with the normal building pipeline (Minkowski shadow, height-graded fill); {'highway':'track'} on a line part draws as a road.

footprint.description: [[x,y], ...] in local metres. For kind='area' (minimum 3 points): NOT closed (the first point is not repeated) -- construct.py closes the ring. For kind='line' (minimum 2 points): an open polyline in point order, drawn exactly as given -- repeat the first point at the end if a closed loop (e.g. a perimeter track) is wanted.

frontage.description: Where and which way the structure's access road connects. localPoint is where the road ends at the structure; localDirection is the outward-facing normal the road should approach along.
